items.description: Knowledge bases, forums, and learning resources for reverse engineering and file formats.

children.title: RetroReversing
children.description: Curated list of retro game development and reverse-engineering resources, tools, and documentation, published as the RetroReversing.com website/wiki.

children.title: XeNTaXBackup
children.description: Public backup of the XeNTaX game file format reverse engineering forum and wiki, preserving community knowledge on game format documentation, QuickBMS scripts, and format research.

children.title: oldgamescracking.github.io
children.description: Community knowledge base documenting cracking and format-preservation notes for old games.

children.title: awesome-gbdev
children.description: Curated list of Game Boy development resources, including reverse-engineering tools, hardware/format documentation, disassemblers, and emulators.

children.title: Awesome PlayStation Vita
children.description: Comprehensive PS Vita resource list including reverse engineering tools, file format decompilers (.rco, .rcs), and RE utilities.

children.title: awesome-gbadev
children.description: Curated list of Game Boy Advance development resources, including documentation, tools, and libraries relevant to GBA file formats and homebrew.

children.title: Architecture of consoles
children.description: Series of technical articles on console hardware architecture, covering CPU, graphics, and file/memory layout across many platforms.

children.title: Pan Docs
children.description: The single, most comprehensive technical reference to the Game Boy hardware available to the public, including cartridge header, memory bank controller, and save format documentation.

children.title: rom-properties
children.description: Shell extension for Windows and Linux that shows information about ROM and disc image files. Supports over 500 game and system file formats across dozens of consoles and handhelds.

children.title: awesome-megadrive
children.description: Curated list of Sega Mega Drive/Genesis development resources, including hardware documentation, disassemblers, and format tools.

children.title: gb-ctr
children.description: Game Boy: Complete Technical Reference, an in-depth document covering Game Boy console hardware internals.

children.title: PSVita-RE-tools
children.description: Collection of PlayStation Vita reverse-engineering tools.

children.title: SiliconRE
children.description: Traces, schematics, and technical writeups from silicon-level reverse engineering of custom game console/arcade chips.

children.title: ay-3-8910_reverse_engineered
children.description: Transistor-level reverse engineering of the AY-3-8910 sound chip used in many arcade and home computer systems, with transistor-level schematics, a Verilog model, and a testbench that renders register dumps into audio.

children.title: ps4libdoc
children.description: PS4 library documentation for game development and reverse engineering reference.

children.title: gbadoc
children.description: Community-driven Game Boy Advance technical documentation effort.

children.title: pif_rom_dumper
children.description: Tool for extracting N64 PIF ROM (system firmware) from Nintendo 64 hardware.

children.title: kovidomi/game-reversing
children.description: Beginner learning materials on reverse engineering video games.

children.title: vgmdocs
children.description: Resources and documentation for video game music formats. Includes guides for GBA sound drivers, FM synth presets, conversion tools, and format documentation.

children.title: Inazuma-Eleven-GO-Modding
children.description: Documentation regarding the functions of Inazuma Eleven GO Light/Shadow. Covers game scripting, format specifications, and modding techniques.

children.title: retrore
children.description: Curated list of original and reverse-engineered vintage 6502 game source code, tracking disassembly projects across many classic 8-bit titles.

items.title: 👥 Communities & Wikis

items.description: Multi-format tools that support a wide variety of unrelated games.

children.title: assimp
children.description: The Open Asset Import Library, loading 40+ 3D model formats into one unified data structure. Widely used as the backend for game-format model converters and viewers. See also Assimp.Net below for a .NET wrapper.

children.title: vengi
children.description: Free, open-source, actively maintained voxel editor, thumbnailer, and command-line format converter.

children.title: NifSkope
children.description: Tool for opening and editing the NetImmerse/Gamebryo NIF format used by Morrowind, Oblivion, Skyrim, Fallout 3/NV/4, and more. See also hexabits' fork with Starfield support.

children.title: mviewer
children.description: Reverse engineering tool for viewing and analyzing MView 3D file format.

children.title: psx-modding-toolchain
children.description: Toolchain for PlayStation 1 modding including model and texture tools.

children.title: Noesis-Plugins (leeao)
children.description: Collection of Noesis Python scripts for various game models and textures.

children.title: SEAnim-Docs
children.description: Specification and documentation for the SEModel/SEAnim formats used by CastImporter and related tools.

children.title: Noesis-Py
children.description: Cross-platform (Linux/macOS) reimplementation of Noesis able to load plugins written for the original Noesis, aiming for API compatibility so existing Noesis plugins work unmodified.

children.title: tmd
children.description: JavaScript application for viewing PlayStation 1 TMD models in the browser. Features orbit controls, wireframe mode, and texture support.

children.title: Noesis-help
children.description: Community-written help/documentation for Rich Whitehouse's Noesis, filling gaps in the official documentation.

children.title: CastImporter
children.description: Unreal Engine plugin for importing SEModel, SEAnim, and Cast files. Commonly used with Call of Duty asset extractors.

children.title: Nif-Explorer
children.description: Python tool (using PyFFI) that recursively scans a directory for .nif files containing specific NetImmerse/Gamebryo Block Types or Block Type Properties, copying matches to a results folder.

children.title: heightmap-viewer
children.description: Simple 3D viewer for loading regular heightmaps and special format heightmap files.

children.title: Noesis
children.description: Popular all-in-one tool for previewing and converting 500+ model, texture, and animation formats. Supports batch conversion, has a rich plugin ecosystem, and can handle most common game formats out of the box.

children.title: Noesis Plugins (Durik256)
children.description: Community collection with 150+ plugins for various games including Final Fantasy series, Dark Souls 2, Dead Rising 4, Ridge Racer, NHL 21, and many others.

children.title: Noesis Plugins (Zheneq)
children.description: Community plugins for Megaman X8 (PC), Fatal Frame 4 (Wii), Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (Wii), Planet 51 (Wii), Silent Hill: Shattered Memories (Wii), Fire Emblem (Wii), MT Framework (3DS).

children.title: Noesis Plugins (mrpostiga)
children.description: Additional community-maintained plugin collection.

children.title: noesis_iqe
children.description: Noesis plugin for exporting models to Inter-Quake Export (IQE) format.

children.title: Noesis Plugins (RoadTrain)
children.description: LS3D engine plugin (.4ds format) supporting Mafia: The City of Lost Heaven, Chameleon, Hidden & Dangerous 2, War of Wings.

children.title: noesis_dukemdx
children.description: Noesis plugin for Duke Nukem Extended Model (MDX) format.

children.title: detex
children.description: Low-level library for decompression and manipulation of texture blocks.

children.title: Texture64
children.description: N64 texture ripper and editor, complementing Motex above with editing support.

children.title: Rainbow
children.description: Texture format converter for different consoles' graphics formats, supporting TIM2, Super Robot Wars MX, The 3rd Birthday, and more.

children.title: AnyPalette.js
children.description: JavaScript/Node library reading and writing a wide range of color palette file formats through one unified interface, including game formats such as StarCraft's .pal/.wpe terrain palettes alongside DCC formats (GIMP GPL, Adobe ACO/ASE/ACT, Paint Shop Pro, Paint.NET).

children.title: tim2view
children.description: Viewer, converter, searcher, editor, and scanner/ripper for PS2 TIM/TM2 texture formats, complementing Rainbow's TIM2 conversion support.

children.title: texgenpack
children.description: Compresses, decompresses, and converts texture files using a genetic algorithm. Supports KTX, DDS, ETC2, BC6/BC7, and more.

children.title: ImageHeat
children.description: Texture viewing tool for encoded textures.

children.title: GTX-Extractor
children.description: Extractor for GTX (GX2 Texture) format in Wii U games with bidirectional conversion.

children.title: BNTX-Extractor
children.description: Extractor for BNTX (Binary NX Texture) format in Nintendo Switch games.

children.title: lfgfx
children.description: Python tool for reverse-engineering and analyzing N64 graphics data blobs (display lists, vertex data, textures, palettes).

children.title: DDS.Tools
children.description: Simple DDS and PNG tool set that converts DDS images to PNG images and vice versa on a large scale. Has options for duplicate detection and sorting.

children.title: TexViewer
children.description: Tool to help discover unknown texture formats.

children.title: detex-compress
children.description: Fast texture compression utility built on the detex library, supporting BC1-5 and ETC1 formats.

children.title: Motex
children.description: N64 texture viewer for analyzing and inspecting N64 binary texture data; useful for reverse-engineering game texture formats.

children.title: TextureFinder
children.description: Binary texture extraction utility supporting multiple game texture formats including DXGI and Xbox formats. Helps identify and extract embedded texture data from game binaries.

children.title: swizzleinator
children.description: Library for detiling/deswizzling various image formats. -friendly. Supports PS3, PS4, and X360 texture swizzling/unswizzling.

children.title: BCDec
children.description: All-in-one C++ texture decoding library and tool for BC1-BC7, ETC1/2, and ASTC formats.

children.title: DXTAnalyzer
children.description: PyQt5 utility for viewing DDS headers and identifying pixel formats (DXT1/3/5, BC4/5/6H/7, RGBA8/BGRA8), with experimental PS3 swizzle/unswizzle (Morton Z-order) support for RGBA8 and BC1/2/3.

children.title: PyNVTT
children.description: Python wrapper for NVIDIA Texture Tools (NVTT). Enables DDS texture format conversion and compression for game asset extraction and modding.

children.title: Tilemap Studio
children.description: Tilemap editor for Game Boy, GBC, GBA, NDS, SNES, Genesis, and TG16.

children.title: tmxlite
children.description: Lightweight C++14 parser for Tiled Map Editor's TMX/TSX tilemap format, used by many indie and hobbyist games.

children.title: NitroPaint
children.description: Graphics editor for Nintendo DS image formats.

children.title: See also ptexconv
children.description: for a command-line-only version of its texture and background converter.

children.title: Tile Molester
children.description: Multi-format, user-extensible graphics data editor for viewing and editing tile-based graphics in arbitrary binary files from game consoles.

children.title: gimp-rom-bin
children.description: GIMP plug-in to read/write/convert ROM image, tile, and sprite files.

children.title: chrgfx
children.description: Converts to and from tile-based (CHR) graphics formats used across many retro consoles.

children.title: SNESTilesKitten
children.description: Tile viewer, extractor, and injector for SNES ROM files with HiROM/LoROM support.

children.title: gimp-tilemap-gb
children.description: Console app and GIMP plug-in for importing/exporting Game Boy game tilemaps and tilesets as bitmap images or .GBM/.GBR files. Related to GBTD, GBMB, GBDK, and ZGB.

children.title: Nintendo_DS_Compressors
children.description: Collection of compressors for formats used on Nintendo GBA/DS.

children.title: BMP2BNR
children.description: Converts BMP images to GameCube banner format (BNR).

children.title: nds_texcompress
children.description: Texture compression tool for Nintendo DS texture formats.

children.title: rawtex
children.description: GIMP 2.x save plugin for creating raw texture files for PC, PSP, NDS, PS2, and other architectures handling chunky or compressed pixel data. See also raw2iff, a plugin-driven tool converting RAW pictures to the Amiga IFF ILBM picture format.

children.title: fntlib
children.description: Python library for reading and writing AngelCode BMFont bitmap .fnt font files, a format used by many game engines (cocos2d-x, Geometry Dash, and others) for in-game text rendering.

children.title: blender_magicavoxel
children.description: MagicaVoxel importer for Blender with hierarchy/greedy meshing, voxel hull reduction, and UV-aware material modes.

children.title: MagicaVoxel-Importer
children.description: Godot Engine plugin for importing MagicaVoxel format files as meshes. Supports Godot 3.0+ with import scaling and centering based on voxel resolution.

children.title: Blender_ioEDM
children.description: Experimental Blender importer/exporter for .EDM model files used in DCS World flight simulator. Supports basic geometry, textures, animations, and connectors.

children.title: io_mesh_ninjaripper
children.description: Blender addon for importing NinjaRipper .rip files. Supports Blender 2.78-2.79.

children.title: 3ds-Max-Scripts
children.description: Archive of 3ds Max scripts including model importing scripts for various game formats and utility scripts.

children.title: blender-tooling
children.description: Scripts to import files into Blender.

children.title: dae-cleanup
children.description: Blender add-on for cleaning and post-processing DAE (Collada) files exported from Switch Toolbox, improving compatibility and reducing file size.

children.title: Guilty_Hell_Sprite_Veiwer
children.description: GPU-accelerated viewer for Unity /AssetStudio sprite sheets, with Real-ESRGAN AI upscaling.

children.title: mxs_xnaLara_converter
children.description: MaxScript for importing XNALara/XPS / model files into 3ds Max.

children.title: binwalk
children.description: Firmware analysis tool for identifying and extracting embedded files and data. The Rust version (v3) provides significant speed and accuracy improvements over the original Python version.

children.title: AssetRipper
children.description: GUI tool for extracting assets from Unity serialized files (CAB-\, \.assets, etc.) and asset bundles (\.unity3d*, \.bundle*, etc.) and converting them into the native Unity engine format.

children.title: Universal Extractor 2
children.description: Generic tool to extract files from any type of archive or installer, commonly used to unpack game installers (NSIS, InstallShield, Wise, and many more) before further asset processing.

children.title: GARbro
children.description: Visual novels resource browser and extractor supporting many formats. See also crskycode's fork, which is actively maintained with additional format support.

children.title: Greaseweazle
children.description: Hardware and tools for reading/writing floppy disks at the raw flux level, widely used for archiving copy-protected game floppies.

children.title: innoextract
children.description: Extracts installers created by Inno Setup without running them, commonly used to unpack game installers before further asset processing.

children.title: extract-xiso
children.description: Xbox ISO (XISO) creation, modification, and extraction utility for original Xbox disc images.

children.title: OmniDrive
children.description: Firmware modification for MediaTek MT1959-based Hitachi-LG optical disc drives, enabling raw sector and lead-in/lead-out reading of CD/DVD/BD media including proprietary game discs.

children.title: UWPDumper
children.description: DLL and Injector for dumping UWP applications at run-time to bypass encrypted file system protection.

children.title: Aaru
children.description: Data Preservation Suite for dumping and analyzing media (optical, magnetic, and solid-state) into forensic disc images, with format identification, checksumming, and decoding across a huge range of game and computer platforms. See also libaaruformat, the C implementation of the Aaru image format.

children.title: maxcso
children.description: Fast CSO compression utility for PSP and PS2 game ISO files used with emulators.

children.title: redumper
children.description: Low-level CD dumper utility for bit-perfect optical disc preservation, used by the Redump.org preservation community.

children.title: archives
children.description: Cross-platform archive library for Go supporting many formats. Provides unified API and virtual file systems compatible with .

children.title: unshield
children.description: Library and CLI tool to extract InstallShield CAB archives, commonly used to unpack older game installers before further asset processing.

children.title: GameExtractor
children.description: Multi-game archive tool supporting 4000+ games.

children.title: HxCFloppyEmulator
children.description: HxC floppy drive emulator toolkit; reads and converts a wide range of retro floppy disk image formats, including many game-console/computer-specific ones.

children.title: NDSFactory
children.description: Generic Nintendo DS ROM extraction/repacking tool.

children.title: xvdtool
children.description: Command-line tool for manipulating Xbox One XVD/XVC package files, with support for decryption, hashing, resignation, and VHD conversion.

children.title: ExtractData
children.description: Extraction tool for Japanese visual novel/game archives, using Susie Plugin (.spi) modules to decode proprietary archive and image formats. Originally developed by Yuu.

children.title: dexvert
children.description: Identifies and converts over 3,700 file formats to modern equivalents, including many game-specific archive, texture, and model formats.

children.title: fluxfox
children.description: Floppy disk image library in Rust for emulators, focused on PC platform disk images with initial Amiga/Macintosh/Atari ST support.

children.title: SabreTools
children.description: DAT-based ROM/disc image management tool with advanced editing and sorting features.

children.title: DiskImageTool
children.description: Floppy disk image manager with built-in bitstream analysis, Greaseweazle support, and optional Kryoflux integration.

children.title: RVWorld (RomVault)
children.description: DAT-file-driven ROM set organizer/verifier for identifying, sorting, and repairing game ROM and disc image collections.

children.title: SAMdisk
children.description: Portable disk image utility specializing in copy-protected PC-compatible floppy formats, commonly used to preserve original game floppy disks.

children.title: dreamcast-cdi-burner
children.description: Open-source, portable Linux tool for burning Sega Dreamcast .CDI disc images to physical media.

children.title: RIDE
children.description: Windows tool for low-level raw floppy disk access and browsing legacy filesystems (ZX Spectrum, MS-DOS, and others) found on preserved game disks.

children.title: iPoPS
children.description: Converts PSX discs and ISOs into PBP format for playback on PSP.

children.title: rnc_propack_source
children.description: Decompiled source of Rob Northen Computing's RNC ProPack, a compression format used by many games across multiple platforms.

children.title: playstation-disc-burner
children.description: Open-source, portable Linux tool for burning PS1/PS2 backup discs, with options for patching the disc image before burning.

children.title: isodump
children.description: PlayStation ISO content extraction tool. Extracts files from PSX ISO/BIN images, supports ISO9660 filesystem, XA and STR files. Generates MKPSXISO-compatible XML project files for rebuilding ISOs.

children.title: cicdec
children.description: Unpacker for installers made with Clickteam Install Creator, used to extract game data bundled by that installer format.

children.title: uninno
children.description: Portable command-line unpacking tool for Inno Setup installers, commonly used to unpack game installers before further asset processing.

children.title: Macaron
children.description: Archive unpacker for various visual novel/eroge engine formats.

children.title: powerpacker_src
children.description: Decompiled source of Nico François' PowerPacker, an Amiga-era compression format used by many Amiga games. See also AmigaImploder, decompiled source of another common Amiga game compression tool.

children.title: RTB-QuickBMS-Scripts
children.description: Collection of QuickBMS scripts for various games.

children.title: edccchk
children.description: EDC/ECC checker for raw (2352 bytes/sector) CD images, used to verify game disc dump integrity.

children.title: ps4tools
children.description: Tools for extracting PS4 file formats including PUP, PKG, PFS, and trophy files.

children.title: AssetRipper CLI
children.description: Command-line front-end built on AssetRipper for batch-exporting CG, character portraits, backgrounds, and audio from Unity visual-novel/gacha games via reusable extraction profiles.

children.title: IPFBrowser
children.description: Tool to extract and browse the contents of IPF archive files, used by several NHN/Webzen MMO titles.

children.title: spoondec
children.description: Extractor for Spoon (Xenocode) virtualized installer packages, used to extract game data bundled by that installer format.

children.title: flux-analyze
children.description: Analysis and recovery tool for IBM MFM floppy flux image data.

children.title: innounpy
children.description: Multiplatform Python unpacker for Inno Setup installers, a pure-Python alternative to innoextract for extracting game installer contents.

children.title: mdsx
children.description: Decompressor/decrypter for MDS v2 / MDX disc image formats (DAEMON Tools).

children.title: quickbms-scripts (devinacker)
children.description: Small collection of QuickBMS scripts for extracting game archives, covering MTV Club Dead (), Klik & Play/Click & Create/The Games Factory (, , , ), and Twisted: The Game Show ( directory).

children.title: romrepomgr
children.description: ROM Repository Manager for organizing and deduplicating game ROM/disc image collections.

children.title: dumplib
children.description: Library for working with media images (ROMs, disk images) from older video game consoles.

children.title: PKGTool
children.description: Tool for extracting and repacking PKG files from The Legend of Heroes: Trails of Cold Steel.

children.title: wad-tools
children.description: Tools for WAD archive format (Wii/GameCube). Fork of BFGR WadTools with enhanced command-line options for wadpacker and wadunpacker, including custom output directories and common-key.bin path specification. Supports C++and C++/CLI compilation.

children.title: imploder
children.description: Data/exe files cruncher/decruncher for 68000-based machines, built on the reversed implode/explode routines credited above.

children.title: gogextract
children.description: Shell script for extracting game files from GOG/innoextract archives.

children.title: uwpdumper-rs
children.description: Rust reimplementation of UWPDumper for extracting files from sandboxed UWP applications (including Xbox Game Pass games) via DLL injection into the running process.

children.title: unPAKer
children.description: Generic PAK archive unpacker for game asset extraction.

children.title: L.A.V.E. (Linear Archive Viewer and Extractor)
children.description: Views and extracts game asset archives, with bidirectional sorting by filename, offset, size, or extension.

children.title: universal-explorer
children.description: Viewer/unpacker for a variety of game archive and texture formats across multiple engines.

children.title: StreamZip
children.description: Archive extraction tool for very large (150GB+) game archives with on-the-fly decompression; demonstrated on Cyberpunk 2077.

children.title: dat-creator
children.description: Qt/C++ file archiver with GUI for bundling files into a single DAT container, with an API for loading/extracting; useful for game asset packaging.

children.title: genesis-rom-workshop
children.description: Workshop tool for inspecting and modifying Sega Genesis/Mega Drive ROMs.

children.title: vgmstream
children.description: Audio playback library supporting 1000+ game audio formats including looping, multi-channel streams, and console-specific codecs. Works as a standalone player or Winamp/foobar2000 plugin. If a game audio file exists, vgmstream probably plays it.

children.title: vgmtrans
children.description: Video Game Music Translator; converts proprietary game audio sequence/soundfont formats from many games/consoles into standard MIDI/DLS/SF2.

children.title: BassoonTracker
children.description: Web-based old-school Amiga music tracker in plain JavaScript. Plays and edits Amiga Mod files and FastTracker XM files.

children.title: Wwise-Unpacker
children.description: Windows tool for extracting audio from Wwise PCK and BNK containers to OGG or MP3 format. Works with any game using Wwise audio middleware.

children.title: jpsxdec
children.description: Cross-platform PlayStation 1 audio and video converter.

children.title: impulse-tracker
children.description: Original source code release for Impulse Tracker, the DOS music tracker behind the widely-used IT module format found in many games' soundtracks.

children.title: ww2ogg
children.description: Converts Wwise RIFF/RIFX Vorbis audio (.wem files) to standard Ogg Vorbis format. Command-line tool with packed codebook support for various encoding variants. Note: vgmstream is recommended for playback, but ww2ogg is useful when Ogg Vorbis output is specifically required.

children.title: ymfm
children.description: BSD-licensed emulation cores for Yamaha FM sound chips (OPM, OPN, OPL, and others) widely used across arcade and console game audio.

children.title: wwiser
children.description: Wwise .bnk explorer and audio simulator. Python tool for parsing Wwise soundbank files, viewing HIRC audio scripting data, generating TXTP files for vgmstream playback, and dumping bank contents. Works with any game using Wwise audio middleware.

children.title: nsfplay
children.description: NSF (Nintendo Sound Format) player and library for NES/Famicom game-music rips, including expansion-audio chip emulation and command-line WAV rendering/metadata utilities.

children.title: VGMusicStudio
children.description: Music player and visualizer for GBA (MP2K format, SDAT) and NDS handheld game audio. Supports playback and extraction with SoundFont2 support, built on the same author's SoundFont2, KMIDI, KFLP, and DLS2 libraries for reading/writing SF2, MIDI, FL Studio project, and DLS files.

children.title: VGAudio
children.description: .NET library for encoding, decoding, and manipulating audio files from video games.

children.title: LoopingAudioConverter
children.description: Tool for converting many game audio formats to looping WAV, OGG, or FLAC files. Supports many console formats through VGAudio and vgmstream.

children.title: OPL3BankEditor
children.description: Cross-platform editor for OPL3 FM instrument bank formats used by numerous DOS-era games and sound drivers (IBK, OP2/GENMIDI, TMB, WOPL, and others).

children.title: wwiseutil
children.description: Tool for manipulating Wwise SoundBank and File Package files. Works with any game using Wwise audio middleware.

children.title: vgmtools
children.description: Collection of tools for the VGM (Video Game Music) file format, including conversion and inspection utilities.

children.title: gbsplay
children.description: Game Boy sound player for GBS (Game Boy Sound) format music rips.

children.title: archive-follin
children.description: Recovered assembler music source code and drivers written by Tim and Geoff Follin for NES/SNES/Genesis games at Software Creations (Silver Surfer, Plok, Solstice, and others), preserved from original 3" floppy disks.

children.title: adpcm
children.description: ADPCM encoder/decoder library and CLI covering game/arcade sound-chip codecs: Yamaha ADPCM-A/B (YM2610/Y8950/YM2608), Yamaha AICA (Dreamcast), Oki/Dialogic VOX (MSM6295 arcade sound chip, MSM6258 X68000), Brian Schmidt BSMT2000/QSound (arcade), and YMZ280B.

children.title: vgm_ripping
children.description: Sources for game music ripping tools.

children.title: Citric-Composer
children.description: Editor for 3DS, Wii U, and Switch sound files. See also Tiniifan's fork.

children.title: es-ps2-vag-tool
children.description: Tool to convert Sony PS2 VAG files to WAV PCM 16-bit encoding and vice versa.

children.title: pmdmini
children.description: C/C++ library for playing back PMD/MXDRV chiptunes from the NEC PC-98, used by many PC-98-era games' Yamaha YM2203/YM2608 soundtracks.

children.title: wwise-audio-tools
children.description: Static and dynamic library plus command-line tool for converting Wwise WEM files to OGG format. Modern replacement for ww2ogg and revorb with easier integration.

children.title: EZNSF
children.description: Tool for transforming NSF (NES Sound Format) music rip files into playable NES ROMs, using Python and the CC65 toolchain.

children.title: gc-dspadpcm-encode
children.description: Nintendo GameCube DSP-ADPCM encoder tool.

children.title: Wwise-BNKExtract
children.description: Extraction utility for Wwise soundbank files (BNK format, file version 113 and earlier). Extracts WEM audio files for conversion to OGG Vorbis format.

children.title: QuattroPlay
children.description: Reimplementation of the Quattro sound driver used in Namco arcade games from the mid-1980s to late 1990s.

children.title: es-ima-adpcm-encoder-decoder
children.description: Tool to convert IMA ADPCM files to WAV PCM 16-bit encoding and vice versa.

children.title: manatools
children.description: Tools for working with Dreamcast audio and music formats (MLT, MPB, MSB).

children.title: SDATTool
children.description: Tool for unpacking and packing Nintendo DS SDAT audio files (SSEQ sequences, SBNK banks, SWAR samples).

children.title: NitroTools
children.description: Toolkit for extracting and editing Nintendo DS SDAT audio.

children.title: PMDDotNET
children.description: .NET port of PMD (Professional Music Driver), a widely-used sound driver/sequence format in PC-98 and other Japanese PC games.

children.title: mod2vgm
children.description: Converts Protracker MOD modules to VGM using the OPL4 chip, for use in game audio pipelines.

children.title: libopenpmd
children.description: Library for parsing PMD (Professional Music Driver) files, the PC-98-era sound driver/sequence format also handled by PMDDotNET and pmdmini above.

children.title: soundbank-editor
children.description: Python-based editor for Wwise soundbank files (.bnk). List, extract, and replace WEM sounds while preserving headers, events, and metadata. Works with any game using Wwise audio middleware.

children.title: WwiseParser
children.description: C# library for parsing Wwise 2016.1 SoundBank object formats. Supports deserializing Wwise objects, rebuilding hierarchies (Master-Mixer and Actor-Mixer), and dumping SoundBank files to JSON. Works with any game using Wwise audio middleware.

children.title: ZENSF
children.description: Tool for building an NES ROM music album from a collection of NSF files using a custom expanded mapper (iNES Mapper 031). See also EZNSF for an easier-to-use alternative.
